name: Invisible City of Sound
description: An architectural cityscape where buildings are shaped like musical instruments and sound waves, visible as colorful ripples in the air, people walking on streets made of harmonics.
prompt: City architecture derived from musical forms: buildings shaped like violins, pianos, speakers, colorful sound waves rippling in the air between structures, people strolling on harmonic streets, vibrant, conceptual, detailed, no text
caption: Where every street sings. 🎵🏙️ #AIArt #SoundCity #ConceptualArt
